primary_records_reviewed: MPT's September 2016 agreement and October closing Form 8-K disclosures: five property purchases, four first-mortgage loans, preferred interests, management-authority limits, transaction dates, leaseback and payment terms.

The 6 October 2010 Massachusetts attorney general's Caritas transaction review: capital constraints and contemporaneous evaluation, public-interest conditions, monitoring and enforcement. Relevant text was checked in the official web rendering and downloaded 64-page PDF, especially printed pp. 13–14, 23, 26–28; a later compliance audit was not inferred.

The Massachusetts administration's 6 May 2024 announcement: filing, that day's operating status, monitoring, patient information and ownership-transition position. Attributed political criticism is not adopted as a court finding.

All five pages of S&P's agreed Statement of Facts were textually reviewed; printed page 3 was independently rendered and visually checked for the February recommendations, counting units and committee action. July actions and CDO criteria were checked in §§12–14.

The 2011 Senate report's credit-rating case introduction, findings and background at printed pp. 243–248, with its issuer-pay and business-pressure discussion. The essay uses bounded congressional findings, not the report's entire crisis-causation account.

The SEC's 12 October 2017 investor bulletin: scope and limitations of credit ratings, potential conflicts under issuer- and subscriber-paid models. Used as later educational explanation, not evidence of 2007 knowledge or present legal requirements.

The Justice Department's 3 February 2015 settlement announcement: date, amount, parties and its account of acknowledged business considerations. The agreement is not called a criminal conviction or a trial verdict on every allegation.
